evidence: Declared repository-authored JATS/TEI/generic XML/HTML gold reproduces expected hierarchy/text for title, abstract, section, paragraph, lists/items, footnote, tables/cells, figures/captions and bibliography/citation observations. Independent fixture expectations name section/paragraph/inline, list/item, note and figure/caption relationships, and exact source byte slices.

Exact namespace recognition preserves default/prefix JATS and TEI P5 while foreign familiar local names remain typed unknowns. Adjacent empty unknown elements retain distinct original byte anchors, separate named projections and exact raw hierarchy. Physical byte offsets are separate from half-open decoded Unicode code points. UTF-8/BOM UTF-16/declared Latin-1, supplementary scalars, cross-inline NFC composition, physical CRLF/CR, numeric/predefined entities and literal CDATA stay truthful.

Core checks independently supplied source/producer/job/attempt/raw-artifact digest/length/media authority, strict unique UTF-8 JSON, preorder element identities and nearest source parent, markup separation, owned text coverage and exact source-content intervals. Each IR node/projection names one validated raw element. Cells have the existing required direct-table IR parent; raw row/group ancestry is retained. Nested tables/figures remain distinct, explicit spans stay bounded, unsupported/duplicate geometry is retained as unknown/ambiguous, and missing/duplicate reference targets remain unresolved/ambiguous. No citation, confidence, row, preview or scholarly authority is invented.

The worker has no paths, fetch, storage or Core imports. Core parses only the strict raw receipt through NativeStructureWorkerPort and exposes staged IR through the existing handoff, with no acceptance/canonical write capability. Source bytes and raw artifact receipts retain their protected provenance.

Fresh complete parser suite covers native four-format gold plus namespace/encoding/byte/text/unknown/table/figure/reference integrity, cancellation before/during extraction, source/output bounds, active/fetching HTML, DTD/entity/PI/malformed/depth denial, and strict hostile raw-receipt substitutions. Content-free failures retain no private exception context and expose no partial IR.

Existing actual test-owned SQLCipher/encrypted-object and native-session protected-source tests remain selected, including current rights/Intent/privacy/source substitutions and read/delivery cancellation or denial. Native algorithms execute on synthetic bytes; the transport handoff is explicitly a port double and does not prove LPAC launch or raw persistence. Existing native intake classification regression passes without expanding production format admission.

Affected format/lint, ordinary-import nonincremental product and nonfixture contract-test types, exact new portable native schema plus unchanged IR schema snapshots, and architecture checks pass. The pre-implementation missing-module observation and development lint corrections remain preserved as development observations rather than boundary qualification.

Added worker native extraction, strict Core native raw contract/semantic validator, additive parent-owned native delivery port and staged adapter, native portable schema/generator mapping, explicitly synthetic gold and hostile/malformed/identity cases, architecture/contract/fixture documentation, and the acceptance worksheet. Source hierarchy/text/attributes and unknown locations are retained in the protected raw artifact; existing IR/request/result versions remain unchanged.

No database migration, UI/reference change, parser dependency, cryptography/security authority, accepted-head writer, runtime build or automation-framework source development is selected. Existing taskctl claim and checked generated review views publish real IN_PROGRESS state. Actual isolated native/Docling launch, encrypted raw persistence, offline assets, resource/restart/recovery and slice/Wave qualification remain ordered T03/later gates.
